run_MaxCutTest: run the MaxCutTest unittest suite to verify max cut location on VGG, ResNet, and Transformer models
test_max_cut_VGG_inference: test the max cut algorithm on a VGG11 model in eval mode and verify expected cut nodes
test_max_cut_VGG_training: test the max cut algorithm on a VGG11 model in train mode and verify expected cut nodes
test_max_cut_ResNet_inference: test the max cut algorithm on a ResNet18 model in eval mode and verify expected cut nodes
test_max_cut_TransformerDecoderLayer: test the max cut algorithm on a TransformerDecoderLayer model in eval and train modes
